search.dialogDescription: Choose a result, preview it, and open the note.
search.previewEmpty: Choose a result to preview it here.

favorite.title: Favorites
favorite.empty: Nothing saved yet. Save one from the filters in the search modal.

list.placeholder: Choose a note from search to read it here. Notes grow out of your conversations with Claude.

browse.chooseCategory: Choose a category on the left to see its notes.
browse.empty: There are no notes in this category.
browse.loadError: Could not load the note list.

related.dialogDescription: Shows notes linked to the current note and notes with similar content.
related.previewEmpty: Choose an item to preview it here.

note.talk: Talk to Claude about this note

file.label: Files:
file.detached: Removed from this note (the file itself stays)
file.fetchIncomplete: Could not retrieve it (still not on this device)
file.unavailable: Can’t be opened on this device (by setting)
file.large: Large file (over {{limit}}MB) — syncing may take a while
file.forcedLocalOnly: This file lives in a work repository, so it is kept unsynced
file.needNote: Open a note before dropping files
file.purgeScope: Removes it from this device and from future syncs. It stays in history that has already been synced, so other devices can still retrieve it.
file.purgeShared: {{count}} other file(s) share the same content, so the data itself stays
file.purgeSuperseded: A newer version points at this one as the version it replaced
file.purgeOnlyCopy: This came from a conversation and has no original file. Removing it cannot be undone
file.purgedKeptObject: Removed from the ledger. The data stays because another file shares the same content
file.purgedKeptBytes: Removed, but the stored data could not be deleted: {{error}}
file.purgeStillUsed: {{count}} note(s) still hold this file. Removing it takes it out of those notes
